minimal_local_slice_contract.scope: Original LIS settings page + explicit anonymous local persistence only. No commlis object creation, TCP/server/serial open, DNS resolution, timers, HL7, sample/task/upload or device status changes.
minimal_local_slice_contract.persistence: Retain the nine original visible keys/types and preserve inactive-mode values, all twelve hidden keys and unrelated accepted keys. Use separate tagged settings/lis.ini or equally isolated explicit root, bounded actual-byte reads, cooperative lock/conflict detection, checked UTF-8 encoding and atomic commit. No current-directory old-config discovery.
minimal_local_slice_contract.load_defaults: Missing source behavior may initialize an explicitly incomplete local configuration: no guessed endpoint/device/baud, source-known sample mode0 and flagsfalse; actual deployment defaults remain unknown. Do not mistake initial incomplete state for usable connectivity.
minimal_local_slice_contract.validation: At minimum validate enum/type, boolean representation, sampleMode0/1, bounded/control-character-free text and exact declared baud choices locally. Original ip/port validator parameters above are evidence, not proof of real-address validation. Before choosing stricter IPv4/hostname/IPv6 or port0/1..65535 semantics, record the intentional scope/difference; never validate by attempting connection. Unknown legacy values remain visible/preserved until explicitly edited, no silent coercion.
minimal_local_slice_contract.serial_list: Use fixed injected anonymous port names for offline tests; read-only platform enumeration is separate and never opens a device. Preserve missing saved name as unavailable. Empty list must not select first device/none as a real usable endpoint.
minimal_local_slice_contract.drafts: Keep per-mode draft values on toggling. Save updates committed snapshot only after actual checked commit, reports local-save result with communication still off. Repeat Save no-op may not write unchanged bytes. Reopen restores exact saved visible values and retained hidden/unrelated data.
minimal_local_slice_contract.failure_and_cancel: Read/parse/tag/permission/disk/serialization/commit/conflict errors retain original bytes/committed snapshot and draft, report real failure and allow retry. Unified requestLeave handles continue/discard across subpage/main-page switch, login/logout/close; no new Cancel button or business-area layout. Busy states guard all hidden pages and normal exit; use GUI receipt as test completion barrier, not direct worker spy alone.
minimal_local_slice_contract.identity: Preserve original local-settings access and single AccountStore session, no role-number-derived new ACL. Login/settings do not change actionReady or LIS connected state.
minimal_local_slice_contract.release: Only after independent local cases, replace index4 through actual attach chain, run unified cumulative regression and matching three-target/package validation. Local source compile/runtime/Windows-original behavior/RK screen/input/resources/real LIS remain separate statuses.
